channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: Nvidia prepares to oust Jensen Huang, WSJ reports — stock sinks
item.description: The report comes days after Huang admitted to an affair with a woman who is believed by U.S. intelligence of being a Chinese spy.

item.title: Jensen Huang affair in D.C.: Resignation calls and moves to tighten Nvidia China exports
item.description: Huang was notably opposed to strict export controls on AI chips to China, which ruffled feathers with congressional China hawks.

item.title: Feds arrest top official of healthcare company, alleging illegal drug importation
item.description: U.S. officials are accusing two top officials of a Canadian company of operating a scheme to illegally import prescription drugs, court records show.

item.title: Nasdaq gains more than 1% as CoreWeave spike revitalizes AI trade
item.description: Stocks rose Wednesday, boosted by sharp gains in CoreWeave and a rebound in Nvidia following back-to-back losing sessions for the chipmaker.

item.title: Canada’s ambassador warns Trump tariffs are driving up costs, threatening U.S. investment
item.description: U.S.-Canada trade tensions persist as Trump's tariffs drive up costs, threaten investment and complicate negotiations between the two countries.

item.title: Insiders are starting to buy this retail turnaround story, so I am too
item.description: Now that corporate insiders are starting to buy in, I believe the turnaround has some legs.

item.title: Mississippi Senate: Scott Colom lead over Hyde-Smith pops to more than 4,400 votes
item.description: Tuesday was the deadline for provisional ballots to be resolved in Mississippi, and the deadline for the receipt of mail-in absentee ballots.

item.title: CoreWeave soars more than 24% for best day since April 2025 after strong Q3 report
item.description: Neoclouds such as CoreWeave, Nebius and IREN have come under scrutiny this month as investors assessed the sustainability of the AI trade.

item.title: Prediction markets tied to clinical trials and drug approvals draw lawmakers' ire
item.description: Sens. Angela Alsobrooks and Ron Wyden are asking what steps the Department of Health and Human Services has taken to mitigate risks from the markets.

item.title: Social Security could pay full benefits until 2059 if taxable payroll kept pace with GDP: AARP report
item.description: An aging work force is not the only reason Social Security's trust funds now have a looming shortfall, according to AARP Public Policy Institute research.

item.title: United Airlines moves to block AI agents from its platform over security concerns
item.description: Companies across industries ⁠are ‌taking divergent approaches to the ⁠rapid rise of AI agents capable of carrying out tasks on behalf of users.

item.title: American Airlines brings fresh food back to NY-Chicago first class for first time since 2019
item.description: American Airlines' first-class food options include sandwiches, fruit and chia bowls

item.title: Measles is surging in the U.S. — and outbreaks can cost millions
item.description: A new tool developed by Johns Hopkins researchers estimates that the 2025 measles outbreak in the U.S. carried an economic cost of more than $37 million.

item.title: Bouncing Wynn Shares might be primed for the 'wheel strategy'
item.description: From a valuation standpoint, WYNN is trading very close to its five-year historical averages across key metrics. So how should traders play this setup?

item.title: Meta head of infrastructure will leave and be succeeded by former AWS cloud exec
item.description: Meta's head of infrastructure and co-head of engineering Santosh Janardhan will leave in 2027, with former AWS senior vice president David Brown taking over.

item.title: Stick with high-quality AI bonds as debt worries persist, says Morgan Stanley
item.description: Morgan Stanley sees a more attractive entry point in high-quality hyperscaler bonds as investors remain wary of the debt funding the AI build-out.

item.title: JetBlue unveils new first-class seats to bring back profits
item.description: JetBlue gave reporters a look at its new first-class seats on Wednesday.

item.title: How Democrats could snarl Trump administration stakes in private sector companies
item.description: The Trump administration had established some form of equity position in 41 companies as of November, according to the CATO Institute's tally.

item.title: CFTC investigates if Kalshi improperly self-certified event contracts
item.description: News of the probe comes after the CFTC ordered Kalshi to take down a sports-related "mention markets" back in August.

item.title: WNBA Finals MVP Gabby Williams: 'Our existence is political'
item.description: Golden State Valkyries star Gabby Williams speaks about winning the WNBA championship, being named Finals MVP, and the culture war over women's sports.

item.title: Costco is giving shareholders a big, early holiday gift. How to make sure you get it
item.description: Costco announced a special dividend, and it's not too late to get in on the action.

item.title: The best military personal loans of November 2026
item.description: For service members looking for a loan, Navy Federal Credit Union, USAA and Upgrade offer some of the best options.

item.title: Zelenskyy warns Ukraine is 'not real estate' as experts say a Russia peace deal remains elusive

item.title: American soldier arrested on suspicion of spying for Russia

item.title: Capri Holdings names longtime Estee Lauder executive Justin Boxford new CEO
item.description: Michael Kors parent Capri on ​Wednesday named Justin Boxford to replace ‌company veteran John Idol as CEO, effective January 4.

item.title: Tired of spending time fixing other people's AI slop at work? How to talk to them about it

item.title: General strikes to paralyze Spain as protestors clash with police ahead of election campaign

item.title: Nissan cuts sales forecast again on China woes as CEO outlines plan to fight back

item.title: Rep. Jim Jordan, Sen. John Thune elected GOP leaders in Congress
item.description: House Speaker Mike Johnson, R-La., announced the day after Election Day he would not run for minority leader in the 120th Congress.

item.title: White House vows to press ahead with tariffs despite midterm backlash over rising prices
